scope: Exactly three source-grounded character motion concepts, three keyframes each; Hers original plus one correction retained.
policy: Existing concept project continued. Sequential builtin generation; no third-party generation scripts, raster postprocessing, globals, runtime integration or push.

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE wide 1536x1024 pixel-art character motion concept board, exactly THREE equal panels left-to-right. Image 1 is an appearance/style reference, NOT an edit target. Use the same older receding grey-haired stern man Hers, dark charcoal long wool coat, bone linen collar, plain brown belt, worn brown boots and one ordinary iron operation key attached to his left hip throughout. Simplify modern lapels to plain medieval closure, otherwise preserve identity and silhouette. Full bodies visible, ample margins, crisp chunky pixel clusters and dark outlines, restrained reference earth palette, flat opaque neutral grey background, no text or headings. Same fixed slightly elevated three-quarter camera, scale and ground baseline in every panel. A single waist-high stone shelf with a single closed brown ledger is at LEFT of each panel, IDENTICAL screen-relative placement, size, book orientation and closed state across all panels. At the start Hers stands immediately RIGHT of this shelf. Panel1: his protective hand has just withdrawn a small distance ABOVE the closed ledger, visibly releasing it, weight shifting away. Panel2: he turns toward the open RIGHT side and takes first step right away from shelf, hands empty. Panel3: he takes a second distinct step farther RIGHT, turned away, hands empty, still fully in frame. Shelf and ledger never move, remain clearly visible at original left-hand location, do not follow him; no paper or book carried. Body travels progressively right, do not center him independently in each frame. This is ONLY the conditional fleeing branch after actual apparatus disconnection, not successful escape. Do not draw apparatus, weapons, combat, magic, guards, other characters, escape completion, death, surrender, redemption or political outcome. The three postures are proposed motion keyframes, not engine-ready animation. Three clean panel divisions, no arrows, labels, duplicates within panels or props beyond fixed shelf/book and worn outfit/key.

entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the THREE-panel Hers retreat board to correct. Keep the entire panel1 and panel2 poses, all three original stone shelves and closed brown ledgers, their original positions, all faces, camera, background, frame divisions, scale, hands, outfit colors and belt key attachment unchanged. The crucial correction is PANEL3 ONLY: make it a clearly distinct SECOND STEP, with the OPPOSITE leg leading from panel2. Panel2 has his anatomical LEFT leg leading toward screen right and RIGHT leg trailing. In PANEL3 plant his anatomical RIGHT boot ahead at far right and bring his LEFT boot behind as the following leg, with natural slight bend and a small additional body shift right within panel margins. Show the back/outer side of his right leg now clearly in front; do not simply translate the existing pose. Same man, same coat, same empty hands and same key attached to his left hip. Keep both boots entirely within panel3. Closed ledger must remain fixed on original shelf well behind him, never move, open or enter his hands. Also simplify the conspicuously modern notched coat lapels to a plain straight medieval wool-coat neckline in ALL three panels, retaining existing charcoal silhouette and bone linen inner collar; change no other costume detail. No added props, apparatus, people, weapon, labels, glow, escape completion or narrative outcome. This is the conditional retreat after disconnection, ending mid-motion still on camera, not proof of successful escape. Preserve the crisp muted medieval pixel-art appearance, no raster smoothing. Primary goal is a distinct alternate-leg second step in third panel.

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE wide 1536x1024 pixel-art character motion concept board with exactly THREE equal panels left-to-right. Image1 is appearance/style reference ONLY. Copy ONLY Sel, the GREY-BEARDED MALE ARTISAN IN THE RIGHT HALF; exclude the woman Nell completely. Same adult man with short grey hair and grey beard, russet tunic with rolled sleeves, charcoal leather apron, brown belt with ordinary tongs attached to his left hip, brown trousers and boots. Crisp hard-edged chunky pixel clusters, restrained russet/charcoal/brown palette, opaque flat neutral grey background, no glow or soft gradient, no text. Same full-body three-quarter pose facing diagonally toward screen RIGHT, same fixed camera, ground baseline, body size and feet across all panels. Action ONLY in arm extension. ONE SAME small rectangular partly-written cream debt ticket, same shape/size/orientation held in HIS RIGHT HAND throughout. His right index finger is visibly pressed onto the SAME small lower guarantor box area on the paper in every panel; do not switch hands or shift finger to another field. A few tiny unreadable ink strokes occupy only the upper part of paper, with a clearly EMPTY recipient field. Angle paper face to camera so covered box and empty field are visible. Panel1: elbow bent, note held close to torso at waist height. Panel2: elbow begins opening, SAME note moves outward to right at waist height; finger stays over guarantor box. Panel3: right arm reaches an offered position, still HIS grip and HIS finger retaining the note; left arm remains naturally at his side. Paper never leaves his hand. No second hand touching paper, no recipient, signature, acceptance, transfer, payment, debt cancellation, pen, table, weapon or other character. Do not invent legible letters or a recipient name. Preserve one figure per panel, both full boots visible, same tool attachment and clothing throughout. This is a source-bounded investigation-opening offer, not completion of a debt-shift outcome. Three clean panel divisions, no labels or arrows. Concept keyframes, not engine-ready sprites.

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE wide 1536x1024 pixel-art character motion concept board, exactly THREE equal panels left-to-right. Image1 is the identity, outfit, stool and style reference, not a request to repeat three seated gestures. Same adult Yani with greying brown hair, short stubble, taupe-brown short cloak clasped at shoulder, olive tunic with pale rolled cuffs, plain brown belt, grey-brown trousers fully and naturally covering both legs, worn brown boots. Same short timber stool. Crisp pixel clusters and dark contours, muted earth/olive/taupe palette, flat opaque neutral grey background, no glow or soft gradients. Full body including both boots in each panel; same fixed slightly elevated three-quarter camera, same person scale and ground baseline, ample headroom for standing. Stool is rigid and stays at IDENTICAL screen-relative position in all panels; do not redraw its design or move it. Yani faces diagonally toward screen RIGHT throughout. Panel1: neutral seated posture on stool matching first reference pose, hands resting near knees, feet planted. Panel2: deliberate restrained forward lean, hips visibly LIFTING JUST OFF stool seat, knees still bent and torso rising, both feet remain supported. Hands may press lightly on his own thighs, no assistant or aid. Panel3: Yani upright immediately in FRONT OF same stool, hips clearly raised and knees straight enough for standing; stool now visible behind him unchanged; arms relaxed, hands neutral. Stop at standing, no walking away, salute or heroic pose. Legs remain covered by same ordinary trousers in ALL frames. Do not invent or reveal any brace/prosthesis design, injury, cure, weapon, recruitment, political agreement, payment scene or additional person. This movement occurs only after actual individual receipt/payment and remaining-debt recording conditions, while present, alive and willing; the image must not imply medical recovery or agreement to return to service. Exact rising mechanics are an art proposal requiring later review. Three clean panel divisions, no text, arrows, labels or UI. Concept keyframes, not engine-ready animation.
